# AWK — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created AWK?", "Aho, Weinberger, Kernighan"),
    ("What paradigm is AWK?", "text processing"),
    ("What is creator?", "Aho, Weinberger, Kernighan"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1977"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "text processing"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".awk"),
    ("What is hello world?", "{print \"Hello, world!\"}"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
